name: Push notifications
description: Delivers push notifications to your customers' phones, apps and websites through OneSignal or Firebase Cloud Messaging. Steward decides who is notified (one customer, bulk sends from Marketing, automatic payment and renewal alerts); this plugin delivers them.
author: Steward

secrets.label: Firebase service account key (the JSON file's contents)

onesignalAppId.title: OneSignal App ID
onesignalAppId.description: From OneSignal → Settings → Keys & IDs. Leave empty to not use OneSignal.

onesignalIdentity.title: How your app identifies customers to OneSignal
onesignalIdentity.description: The id your app passes to OneSignal.login(): the Steward user id, or your own user id (the customer's external id in Steward).
